COALESCE(e.payload->'model_usage', e.payload->'usage')->>'input_tokens' ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(COALESCE(e.payload->'model_usage', e.payload->'usage')->>'input_tokens' AS bigint) END), 0) AS input_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(e.payload->'model_usage', e.payload->'usage')->>'output_tokens' ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(COALESCE(e.payload->'model_usage', e.payload->'usage')->>'output_tokens' AS bigint) END), 0) AS output_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(e.payload->'model_usage', e.payload->'usage')->>'cache_read_input_tokens' ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(COALESCE(e.payload->'model_usage', e.payload->'usage')->>'cache_read_input_tokens' AS bigint) END), 0) AS cache_read_input_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(e.payload->'model_usage', e.payload->'usage')->>'cache_creation_input_tokens' ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(COALESCE(e.payload->'model_usage', e.payload->'usage')->>'cache_creation_input_tokens' AS bigint) END), 0) AS cache_creation_input_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(e.payload->'model_usage', e.payload->'usage')->'cache_creation'->>'ephemeral_5m_input_tokens' ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(COALESCE(e.payload->'model_usage', e.payload->'usage')->'cache_creation'->>'ephemeral_5m_input_tokens' AS bigint) END), 0) AS cache_write_5m_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(e.payload->'model_usage', e.payload->'usage')->'cache_creation'->>'ephemeral_1h_input_tokens' ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(COALESCE(e.payload->'model_usage', e.payload->'usage')->'cache_creation'->>'ephemeral_1h_input_tokens' AS bigint) END), 0) AS cache_write_1h_tokens, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM session_events result JOIN session_events call ON call.workspace_uuid = result.workspace_uuid AND call.session_external_id = result.session_external_id AND call.event_type = 'agent.tool_use' AND call.deleted_at IS NULL AND call.external_id = COALESCE(result.tool_use_id, CASE WHEN result.payload_blob_uuid IS NULL THEN result.payload->>'tool_use_id' END) AND call.payload->>'name' = 'web_search' WHERE result.workspace_uuid = #{params.WorkspaceUUID} AND result.session_external_id = #{params.SessionExternalID} AND result.event_type = 'agent.tool_result' AND result.deleted_at IS NULL AND COALESCE(result.payload->>'is_error', 'false') <> 'true' AND (#{params.ThreadExternalID} = '' OR result.thread_external_id = #{params.ThreadExternalID}) ) AS web_search_requests FROM session_events e WHERE e.workspace_uuid = #{params.WorkspaceUUID} AND e.session_external_id = #{params.SessionExternalID} AND e.event_type = 'span.model_request_end' AND e.deleted_at IS NULL
AND e.thread_external_id = #{params.ThreadExternalID}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(GREATEST(CAST(ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (e.created_at - s.created_at)) * 1000) AS bigint), 0)), 0) FROM session_events e JOIN session_events s ON s.workspace_uuid = e.workspace_uuid AND s.session_external_id = e.session_external_id AND s.external_id = e.payload->>'model_request_start_id' AND s.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE e.workspace_uuid = #{params.WorkspaceUUID} AND e.session_external_id = #{params.SessionExternalID} AND e.event_type = 'span.model_request_end' AND e.deleted_at IS NULL
AND e.thread_external_id = #{params.ThreadExternalID}

SELECT to_char(result.processed_at AT TIME ZONE #{query.Timezone}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS day, call.payload->>'name' AS name, COALESCE(result.payload->'tool_price'->>'cny', '') AS cny, COALESCE(result.payload->'tool_price'->>'per', '') AS per, COALESCE(result.payload->'tool_price'->>'exchange', '') AS exchange, COUNT(*) AS searches FROM session_events result JOIN session_events call ON call.workspace_uuid = result.workspace_uuid AND call.session_external_id = result.session_external_id AND call.event_type = 'agent.tool_use' AND call.deleted_at IS NULL AND call.external_id = COALESCE(result.tool_use_id, CASE WHEN result.payload_blob_uuid IS NULL THEN result.payload->>'tool_use_id' END) AND call.payload->>'name' = 'web_search' WHERE result.organization_uuid = #{query.OrganizationUUID} AND result.workspace_uuid IN #{workspace} AND result.event_type = 'agent.tool_result' AND result.deleted_at IS NULL AND COALESCE(result.payload->>'is_error', 'false') <> 'true' AND result.processed_at >= #{query.Start} AND result.processed_at < #{query.End} AND result.processed_at <= #{query.AsOf} AND result.session_external_id = #{query.SessionID} GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT COALESCE(result.payload->'tool_price'->>'cny', '') AS cny, COALESCE(result.payload->'tool_price'->>'per', '') AS per, COALESCE(result.payload->'tool_price'->>'exchange', '') AS exchange, COUNT(*) AS searches FROM session_events result JOIN session_events call ON call.workspace_uuid = result.workspace_uuid AND call.session_external_id = result.session_external_id AND call.event_type = 'agent.tool_use' AND call.deleted_at IS NULL AND call.external_id = COALESCE(result.tool_use_id, CASE WHEN result.payload_blob_uuid IS NULL THEN result.payload->>'tool_use_id' END) AND call.payload->>'name' = 'web_search' WHERE result.workspace_uuid = #{params.WorkspaceUUID} AND result.session_external_id = #{params.SessionExternalID} AND result.event_type = 'agent.tool_result' AND result.deleted_at IS NULL AND COALESCE(result.payload->>'is_error', 'false') <> 'true' AND (#{params.ThreadExternalID} = '' OR result.thread_external_id = #{params.ThreadExternalID}) GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
